_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: comic strip panel, black brush-pen ink line with muddy early-2000s digital flat colors, rubbery kinetic linework, mid-2000s webcomic look, limited palette, slightly misregistered fills. model sheet of a thin man in his mid-twenties, hunched, black hoodie open over a dark band tee with a faded eagle, ink-stained right hand, tired eyes; front, profile, seated at a CRT pose, plus a second figure of the same man at two-thirds scale beside a normal-scale scruffy dog; expression heads: manic, resigned, bemused, wry; labeled WOOD 2006. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: photorealistic, 3D render, painterly, glossy, watermark, extra fingers
